title: Pip and the Helper School
source: Storyteller round 2 (v5 prompt), transcribed from Sally's evidence screenshot in the team report 5.2
note: setting (time, place) is a Producer placeholder. Storyteller should supply it per page, since only the script knows when and where the story happens. Values are limited to time: day, dusk, night and place: street, campus, classroom, office, rooftop, bedroom, plain. The written scene_description from the Storyteller schema was removed: the renderer builds each scene from slot, tone, and setting, so it never read that field.

script_5to7.text: Pip is a little robot owl. Pip reads the news at night.
A school and a company made a plan. They help new workers learn to use AI tools.
New workers learn from older workers. Pip peeks in the window.
One new worker learned little about AI in school. Pip feels lost with new tools too.
A leader said new workers are still needed.
Now they take classes and get a helper. Pip claps her wings.
Learning is for everyone. Maybe you will learn AI tools one day too.
Carnegie Mellon and Microsoft made a program. New workers get help from workers who know more.
Quiz time! Let's see what you remember.

script_8to10.text: Pip is a small robot owl. She reads the news each night. Tonight, one story makes her feathers fluff up.
Carnegie Mellon and Microsoft started a program called PRAISE. It helps new software engineers use AI tools well. Software engineers write the code that makes apps work.
The new engineers take classes online. They also get a coach who knows the job well.
Jace Watson's college did not teach him much about AI tools. A leader saw that AI helps skilled engineers more than new ones. Maybe new tools feel hard when no one shows you how.
Mark Russinovich is a leader at Microsoft. He said AI does not remove the need for new engineers. Pip likes that. Everyone has to start somewhere.
Now the engineers learn in class and with a coach. Their classes can count toward a master's degree.
Pip thinks smart tools work best with people who keep learning. Maybe one day you will learn with an AI tool and a good teacher.
Carnegie Mellon and Microsoft launched PRAISE. New engineers get coaching from senior engineers at Microsoft. The idea started with a visit to CMU in October 2025.
Quiz time! Let's see what you remember.
